examples: A group named sleepy with the sleeping icon lit lists every agent that is asleep, with no dragging.
A group with the coffee icon lit and the prefix api- collects every kept-awake agent whose name starts with api-.
how_to: Open a group's heading menu (the three dots) and choose rule.
Click an icon to require that attribute (lit means required): running, sleeping, coffee, sharing, pinned, another computer, swarm, unread, waiting on you.
Type a prefix and or a suffix to match the agent's name; the count shows how many agents match right now.
A session joins the group when it matches every lit criterion. Agents you added by hand stay in the group either way.
